validation: Checked with the structural catalogue gate and deterministic re-authoring. The bundled three-page Lucid template passes the bundled visual-standard checker with zero findings, and the checker caught all 18 seeded defects on mutated copies. The template was not imported into Lucidchart. Bundle benchmark 04/11/26 (whole persona core vs no skill, one frontier model, isolated no-tool sessions, deterministic scorers): all 14 closed decision cases at ceiling in both arms; BPMN artefact at ceiling; Lucid artefact 3/5 -> 4/5; two open-ended tasks, two trials each: first working output 4/6, 4/6 -> 6/6, 6/6; standard-look Lucid map 4/8, 4/8 -> 8/8, 7/8 (scorer corrections recorded). Results apply to the bundle as a whole, not to this skill alone; controller-authored cases, not independent review.
sources: Principles distilled from: OMG BPMN 2.0.2 section 7.5 (text, colour, size and lines); eCH-0158 BPMN modelling conventions v1.2 (Verein eCH, 2020; free use with attribution); D. L. Moody's analysis of the BPMN 2.0 visual notation; the Real-Life BPMN authors' published guidance on symbol size and colour (Camunda best-practice guides); Mendling, Recker and Reijers, On the usage of labels and icons in business process modeling (2010); K. Figl, Comprehension of procedural visual business process models (2017); Luebke, Ahrens and Schneider, layout and scrolling eye-tracking study (2021); W3C WCAG 2.2 success criteria 1.4.1, 1.4.3 and 1.4.11; Lucid help and developer documentation. Paraphrased; no source text reproduced. The bundled style file, template and checker are original.
